(ns sdk-phase-association-probe
 (:require [compile.sdk :as sdk] [expand :as expand] [lower :as lower]))

;; Read-only semantic probe to run AFTER frozen qualification terminates.
;; A valid SDK descriptor is public data; test its association with the
;; surrounding authored declaration, without asking for any native grants.
(let [captured (sdk/capture {:sdk 'core :revision 'selected :only ['inc]})
      binding (first (:bindings captured))
      claim {:namespace (:namespace binding) :name (:name binding)
             :digest (Base/encode16
                      (crypto/hash :sha256 (erlang/term_to_binary binding (list :deterministic)))
                      (list (tuple :case :lower)))}
      provider (assoc (:source captured) :source
                 (str "(ns core) (defn inc " (pr-str {:sdk-phase claim}) " [x] 0)"))
      client {:namespace 'association.client :revision 'current :file "association-client.bl"
              :source (str "(ns association.client) "
                       "(import-world 'core 'selected :only [inc]) "
                       "(begin-for-syntax (import-world 'core 'selected :only [inc])) "
                       "(defsyntax answer [form ctx] "
                       "(syntax-literal (inc (:value (syntax-arg form 1))))) "
                       "[(inc 41) (answer 41)]")}
      program (expand/program [provider client] ['association.client 'current])
      result (lower/eval-anf
               (erlang/binary_to_atom (str "Elixir.SDKPhaseAssociationProbe"
                                           (erlang/unique_integer (list :positive))))
               (:node program))]
 (println :sdk-phase-association-result result))
